_readme: Editorial homepage copy. All visible strings are bilingual {en, zh} objects. Project IDs refer to content/projects.json; the research copy distinguishes the completed master's study from the current PhD.

body.en: I’m a communication designer and researcher based in Melbourne and Taipei. I work across identities, books and exhibitions, exploring how an image can carry more than one idea.
body.zh: 我是杜浩瑋，在墨爾本與台北從事傳達設計與研究。從品牌識別、書籍到展覽，探索一個圖像如何容納不只一種想法。

body.en: A letter becomes a structure. A structure becomes an identity.
body.zh: 字母成為結構，結構成為識別。

body.en: A book cover can pull you in before the first page.
body.zh: 書還沒翻開，故事已經開始。

body.en: An identity takes on another life when you can walk through it.
body.zh: 當識別走進空間，就多了一種觀看的方式。

intro.en: Slice open a D&AD pencil and find a piece of fruit. An exhibition identity built around the pleasure of looking inside.
intro.zh: 切開一枝 D&AD 鉛筆，裡面竟然是水果。從海報到展場，邀請觀眾往裡面多看一眼。

intro.en: H, N and Z share one structure. Rotation and reflection turn it into an identity that works from a hard hat to a building site.
intro.zh: H、N、Z 共用一個結構。旋轉、鏡射之間，成為從安全帽到工地圍籬都能使用的品牌識別。

intro.en: A tall, custom wordmark echoes the profile of a fish. Scales, water and rice become a graphic language for a seafood shop and restaurant in Melbourne.
intro.zh: 修長的訂製字標，藏著魚身的側影。魚鱗、水與米，成為這間墨爾本海鮮鋪與餐廳的視覺語言。

intro.en: A black hole pulls the whole cover towards its centre. Type and linework bend together, making gravity part of the composition.
intro.zh: 黑洞把整張封面往中心拉。文字與線條一起彎曲，讓引力直接成為版面的一部分。

question.en: What becomes the image? What becomes the background?
question.zh: 什麼成為圖像？什麼退到背景？

body.en: My master’s research used projection to turn figure–ground illusions into a repeatable design method. Today, I’m a PhD candidate in Design at Swinburne University of Technology, working with Design Factory Melbourne and ANSTO.
body.zh: 我的碩士研究透過投影，把圖地反轉發展成可以重複操作的設計方法。目前在斯威本科技大學攻讀設計博士，與墨爾本設計工廠及澳洲核能科學技術組織（ANSTO）合作研究。

body.en: For design projects, collaborations and conversations.
body.zh: 設計委託、合作，或交換一些想法。
